marchesa-the-black-rose.plan: Lead with mana and counter access, then use Marchesa’s dethrone and theft effects to attack the highest-life player. Sacrifice countered creatures—especially borrowed threats—so her next-end-step recursion, ETB damage, and value engines convert temporary swings into a resilient board. Counter-based recursion conflicts with undying: a creature dying with a +1/+1 counter cannot use undying.

groups.label: COMMANDER & COUNTER-BASED RECURSION
groups.intro: Marchesa is the deck’s timing-sensitive engine: a creature must die with a +1/+1 counter for her delayed return to work.

cards.name: Marchesa, the Black Rose
cards.role: Gives your creatures dethrone and returns a creature that dies with a +1/+1 counter at the next end step.

groups.label: THEFT & OPPONENT-CREATURE CONVERSION
groups.intro: Steal or copy opposing creatures, then use counters and sacrifice effects to turn temporary control into lasting board presence where the card allows it.

cards.name: Dack's Duplicate
cards.role: Copies a battlefield creature with haste and dethrone, supplying a threat that can earn the counter needed for Marchesa recursion.

cards.name: Enthralling Victor
cards.role: Temporarily steals an opposing creature with power 2 or less, untaps it, and gives it haste for a swing.

cards.name: Mark of Mutiny
cards.role: Steals a creature, adds a +1/+1 counter, and grants haste; sacrifice it while you control it to set up Marchesa recursion.

cards.name: Harness by Force
cards.role: Steals any number of creatures until end of turn, with a separate strive cost for each extra target; sacrifice outlets can turn them into value.

cards.name: Grave Betrayal
cards.role: When a creature you do not control dies, returns it under your control next end step with an extra counter, rewarding opposing losses.

cards.name: Willbreaker
cards.role: Turns your spells or abilities that target opposing creatures into lasting control while it remains on the battlefield.

groups.label: SACRIFICE, COUNTERS & DEATH VALUE
groups.intro: These cards supply sacrifice outlets, counter placement, and death/recursion payoffs; counters are deliberately included because Marchesa’s trigger checks them at death.

cards.name: Ashnod's Altar
cards.role: Sacrifices creatures for two colorless mana, enabling stolen-creature conversion, recursion costs, and death-trigger turns throughout the deck.

cards.name: Carrion Feeder
cards.role: Its free sacrifice ability trades a creature for a counter on itself, converting borrowed threats and setting up Marchesa death triggers.

cards.name: Unspeakable Symbol
cards.role: Pays 3 life to put a +1/+1 counter on a creature, meeting Marchesa’s death-recursion condition.

cards.name: Sage of Fables
cards.role: Other Wizards enter with an extra counter; paying two and removing a creature’s counter draws a card, trading recursion protection for resources.

cards.name: Exava, Rakdos Blood Witch
cards.role: Gives haste to creatures with +1/+1 counters and has unleash, making counter-bearing creatures immediately threatening.

cards.name: Chasm Skulker
cards.role: Grows from card draws and makes 1/1 Squid tokens when it dies, creating sacrifice material.

cards.name: River Kelpie
cards.role: Draws when a permanent enters from a graveyard and when a player casts from a graveyard, rewarding repeated recursion.

cards.name: Feast on the Fallen
cards.role: At each upkeep, an opponent’s life loss last turn can put a counter on your creature, preparing Marchesa’s death-time requirement.

cards.name: Feldon of the Third Path
cards.role: Makes a temporary artifact copy of a creature in your graveyard; the copy is sacrificed at the next end step.

groups.label: RECURSION, ETB DAMAGE & PRESSURE
groups.intro: Hasty and graveyard-returning threats pressure life totals while Flayer and other effects turn creatures entering from the graveyard into damage or value. Important caveat: a +1/+1 counter can stop undying, so counter placement and undying timing conflict.

cards.name: Flayer of the Hatebound
cards.role: Your creatures entering from your graveyard deal their power as damage; undying also returns Flayer if it dies without a +1/+1 counter.

cards.name: Deathbringer Thoctar
cards.role: Gains a counter whenever another creature dies and can remove a counter to deal 1 damage to any target.

cards.name: Hellhole Flailer
cards.role: Can enter with a +1/+1 counter and sacrifices to deal damage equal to its power to a player or planeswalker.

cards.name: Hellspark Elemental
cards.role: Provides a hasty trampling attack; unearth offers another, but its exile replacement prevents that unearthed creature from dying for Marchesa recursion.

cards.name: Chaos Imps
cards.role: A flying creature with unleash; its counter option makes it a stronger Marchesa recursion candidate.

cards.name: Carnival Hellsteed
cards.role: A first-striking, hasty threat whose unleash counter makes it useful in a counter-focused attack plan.

cards.name: Oracle of Bones
cards.role: Haste creature with tribute 2; if tribute is not paid, its entry lets you cast an instant or sorcery from hand for free.

cards.name: Volt Charge
cards.role: Deals 3 damage to any target, then proliferates, potentially increasing existing +1/+1 counters, rad counters, or other counters.

cards.name: Ob Nixilis, Unshackled
cards.role: Flies and tramples; punishes opposing library searches with a sacrifice and 10 life loss, while gaining a +1/+1 counter whenever another creature dies.

groups.label: CARD FLOW & GRAVEYARD UTILITY
groups.intro: Draw, discard, protection, and creature recovery keep the engine supplied and make expendable bodies useful rather than dead cards.

cards.name: Disciple of Bolas
cards.role: Sacrifices another creature, then draws cards and gains life equal to its power, turning expendable bodies into resources.

cards.name: Phyrexian Rager
cards.role: Draws a card and costs 1 life when it enters, providing a replaceable body for sacrifice or recursion.

cards.name: Cadaver Imp
cards.role: Returns a creature card from your graveyard to your hand when it enters, restoring key pieces.

cards.name: Liliana's Specter
cards.role: Makes each opponent discard a card when it enters, adding disruption to a recursive body.

cards.name: Notion Thief
cards.role: Replaces an opponent’s extra card draws with your own, while leaving your normal draw effects intact.

cards.name: Reanimate
cards.role: Returns a creature from any graveyard directly to the battlefield at the cost of life equal to its mana value.

cards.name: Swiftfoot Boots
cards.role: Equips to grant hexproof and haste, protecting Marchesa or another key creature while enabling an immediate attack or activation.

cards.name: Dragon Blood
cards.role: Pays mana and taps to put a +1/+1 counter on a creature, directly enabling Marchesa’s return trigger.

groups.label: MANA ACCELERATION & FIXING
groups.intro: Artifacts accelerate the high-impact theft, recursion, and threat turns while covering all three Grixis colors.

cards.name: Sol Ring
cards.role: Taps for two colorless mana, accelerating Marchesa, counter setup, theft spells, recursion, and expensive threats.

cards.name: Talisman of Dominance
cards.role: Produces blue or black mana, or colorless, for Grixis fixing at the cost of 1 life for colored activation.

cards.name: Talisman of Indulgence
cards.role: Produces black or red mana, or colorless, for Grixis fixing at the cost of 1 life for colored activation.

cards.name: Burnished Hart
cards.role: Sacrifices to search for up to two basic lands and put them onto the battlefield tapped, combining ramp with a death trigger.

cards.name: Obelisk of Grixis
cards.role: Taps for blue, black, or red mana, smoothing Marchesa’s three-color requirements and supporting demanding theft and recursion turns.

groups.label: COMMANDER MANA BASE
groups.intro: The lands provide Grixis colors, utility, and basic-land searching; several enter tapped, so sequencing matters.

cards.name: Command Tower
cards.role: Taps for one mana of any color in Marchesa’s Grixis commander identity, providing unconditional color fixing.

cards.name: City of Brass
cards.role: Taps for one mana of any color, dealing 1 damage whenever it becomes tapped for flexible Grixis fixing.

cards.name: Sulfurous Springs
cards.role: Taps for colorless, or black or red at the cost of 1 damage, supporting Marchesa’s Rakdos colors.

cards.name: Underground River
cards.role: Taps for colorless, or blue or black at the cost of 1 damage, supporting Marchesa’s Dimir colors.

cards.name: Crumbling Necropolis
cards.role: Enters tapped and taps for blue, black, or red, offering complete Grixis fixing at a tempo cost.

cards.name: Rakdos Carnarium
cards.role: Enters tapped, returns a land you control to hand, and taps for two black-red mana for explosive turns.

cards.name: Opal Palace
cards.role: Taps for colorless or, for one mana, any commander-identity color; commander casts can add counters based on command-zone casts.

cards.name: Bojuka Bog
cards.role: Enters tapped, exiles a target player’s graveyard on entry, and taps for black, providing graveyard interaction.

cards.name: Temple of Epiphany
cards.role: Enters tapped, scries 1 on entry, and taps for blue or red, combining selection with Izzet fixing.

cards.name: Evolving Wilds
cards.role: Sacrifices to search for any basic land and put it onto the battlefield tapped, fixing colors and thinning the deck.

cards.name: Terramorphic Expanse
cards.role: Sacrifices to search for any basic land and put it onto the battlefield tapped, fixing colors and thinning the deck.

cards.name: Grixis Panorama
cards.role: Taps for colorless or sacrifices for one mana to fetch a basic Island, Swamp, or Mountain tapped.

cards.name: Swamp
cards.role: Basic land that taps for one black mana, reliably supporting Marchesa’s black spells and colored activations.

cards.name: Island
cards.role: Basic land that taps for one blue mana, reliably supporting Marchesa’s blue spells and interaction.

cards.name: Mountain
cards.role: Basic land that taps for one red mana, reliably supporting Marchesa’s theft spells and damage effects.

the-wise-mothman.plan: Build a Sultai mill-and-counters engine around The Wise Mothman: rad counters and repeated nonland mill events distribute +1/+1 counters among distinct targets, then counter payoffs turn that spread into evasion and damage. Ramp early and use recursion to recover key engine pieces.

groups.label: COMMANDER & MILL-TO-COUNTERS ENGINE
groups.intro: The commander turns entry/attack rad counters and each nonland mill event into distributed +1/+1 counters; an event with X cards milled targets up to X distinct creatures.

cards.name: The Wise Mothman
cards.role: Entry and attacks give everyone radiation; a mill event with X nonlands puts one counter on each of up to X distinct creatures.

groups.label: MILL, RAD COUNTERS & TRIGGER PAYOFFS
groups.intro: These permanents repeatedly mill, create rad counters, or reward deaths and graveyard size; Mothman’s counters are spread among distinct targets rather than piled onto one creature.

cards.name: Nuclear Fallout
cards.role: Each creature gets twice -X/-X until end of turn, and each player gets X rad counters; X is chosen when the spell is cast.

cards.name: Watchful Radstag
cards.role: Larger creatures entering can evolve it and create another Radstag; placing counters with Mothman alone does not trigger evolve.

cards.name: Harold and Bob, First City
cards.role: UNRESOLVED — cannot assess until verified.

cards.name: Agent Frank Horrigan
cards.role: Proliferates twice when it enters or attacks, multiplying existing counters across chosen permanents or players.

cards.name: Strong, the Brutish Companion
cards.role: UNRESOLVED — cannot assess until verified.

cards.name: Lumbering Megasloth
cards.role: Costs less for each counter among players and permanents, and enters tapped with trample; the counter-heavy shell can reduce its cost.

cards.name: Piper Wright, Public Reporter
cards.role: UNRESOLVED — cannot assess until verified.

cards.name: Mesmeric Orb
cards.role: Untaps mill each player for each permanent they untap, supplying repeated mill events for Mothman.

cards.name: Mindcrank
cards.role: Opponent life loss mills that many cards, potentially triggering Mothman when nonlands are milled; Mindcrank itself does not cause life loss.

cards.name: Syr Konrad, the Grim
cards.role: Drains opponents for creature deaths, creature cards milled or discarded, and creature cards leaving your graveyard; its paid ability mills everyone.

cards.name: Stitcher's Supplier
cards.role: Mills three cards on entry and three more when it dies, stocking the graveyard and creating mill events.

cards.name: Altar of the Brood
cards.role: Whenever another permanent you control enters, each opponent mills a card, repeatedly feeding Mothman’s trigger.

cards.name: Drown in the Loch
cards.role: Counters a spell or destroys a creature, with the available mode depending on cards in that player’s graveyard.

groups.label: +1/+1 COUNTER PAYOFFS
groups.intro: These cards convert the distributed counters into larger bodies, evasion, proliferated counters, or graveyard access; Hardened Scales and Corpsejack Menace amplify placement.

cards.name: Alpha Deathclaw
cards.role: Has menace and trample, and its monstrosity puts four +1/+1 counters on it while entering or becoming monstrous destroys a permanent.

cards.name: Hancock, Ghoulish Mayor
cards.role: Counters on Hancock boost your other Zombies and Mutants; adding +1/+1 counters also prevents its undying from triggering at death.

cards.name: Hardened Scales
cards.role: Adds an extra +1/+1 counter whenever one or more +1/+1 counters would be put on a creature you control.

cards.name: Corpsejack Menace
cards.role: Doubles the number of +1/+1 counters put on creatures you control, amplifying Mothman’s distributed counters.

cards.name: Abzan Falconer
cards.role: Gives flying to each creature you control with a +1/+1 counter, converting Mothman’s counters into evasion.

cards.name: Herald of Secret Streams
cards.role: Makes creatures you control with +1/+1 counters unable to be blocked, converting Mothman’s distributed counters into dependable combat damage.

cards.name: Evolution Sage
cards.role: Proliferates whenever a land enters under your control, increasing existing +1/+1, rad, and other counters across the board.

cards.name: Thrummingbird
cards.role: When it deals combat damage to a player, proliferate, extending Mothman’s counter engine across selected permanents and players.

cards.name: Wonder
cards.role: Gives your creatures flying while it is in your graveyard and you control an Island.

cards.name: Genesis
cards.role: During your upkeep from the graveyard, you may pay 2G to return a creature card from your graveyard to your hand.

cards.name: Fiend Artisan
cards.role: Graveyard creatures enlarge it; at sorcery speed, X plus hybrid mana, tapping, and sacrificing another creature tutors a creature costing X or less.

groups.label: RECURSION & GRAVEYARD ACCESS
groups.intro: Milling can put useful creatures into the graveyard rather than losing access to them. Reanimate and Dread Return bring back one creature, while Victimize trades a body for two tapped creatures.

cards.name: Reanimate
cards.role: Returns a creature from any graveyard directly to the battlefield at the cost of life equal to its mana value.

cards.name: Victimize
cards.role: Sacrifices one creature to return two creature cards from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped, trading a body for substantial recursion.

cards.name: Dread Return
cards.role: Returns a creature from your graveyard to the battlefield and can be flashed back by sacrificing three creatures.

groups.label: RAMP & COLOR FIXING
groups.intro: Mana rocks and land tutors accelerate the three-color engine and its expensive payoff creatures.

cards.name: Sol Ring
cards.role: Taps for two colorless mana, accelerating Mothman, mill engines, counter payoffs, and expensive recursion spells.

cards.name: Arcane Signet
cards.role: Taps for one mana of any color in The Wise Mothman’s Sultai commander identity, fixing early development and payoff turns.

cards.name: Simic Signet
cards.role: Pays one mana and taps to produce one green and one blue mana, fixing Sultai colors for Mothman’s engine.

cards.name: Dimir Signet
cards.role: Pays one mana and taps to produce one blue and one black mana, fixing Sultai colors for mill and recursion.

cards.name: Golgari Signet
cards.role: Pays one mana and taps to produce one black and one green mana, fixing Sultai colors for graveyard payoffs.

cards.name: Farseek
cards.role: Searches for a Plains, Island, Swamp, or Mountain card and puts it onto the battlefield tapped.

cards.name: Cultivate
cards.role: Searches for two basic lands, puts one onto the battlefield tapped and the other into your hand, building reliable three-color development.

cards.name: Wayfarer's Bauble
cards.role: Pay two, tap, and sacrifice it to fetch a tapped basic land, fixing Sultai colors without needing green mana first.

groups.label: COMMANDER MANA BASE
groups.intro: These lands fix Sultai colors, with fetch-like lands and basics supporting the ramp package; several lands enter tapped or cost life.

cards.name: Command Tower
cards.role: Taps for one mana of any color in The Wise Mothman’s Sultai commander identity, providing unconditional color fixing.

cards.name: Opulent Palace
cards.role: Enters tapped and taps for blue, black, or green, supplying complete Sultai fixing at a tempo cost.

cards.name: Exotic Orchard
cards.role: Taps for any color a land an opponent controls could produce, flexibly fixing Sultai colors in multiplayer.

cards.name: Llanowar Wastes
cards.role: Taps for colorless, or black or green at the cost of 1 damage, supporting Mothman’s Golgari colors.

cards.name: Yavimaya Coast
cards.role: Taps for colorless, or green or blue at the cost of 1 damage, supporting Mothman’s Simic colors.

cards.name: Underground River
cards.role: Taps for colorless, or blue or black at the cost of 1 damage, supporting Mothman’s Dimir colors.

cards.name: Evolving Wilds
cards.role: Sacrifices to search for any basic land and put it onto the battlefield tapped, fixing Sultai colors for the engine.

cards.name: Terramorphic Expanse
cards.role: Sacrifices to search for any basic land and put it onto the battlefield tapped, fixing Sultai colors for the engine.

cards.name: Forest
cards.role: Basic land that taps for one green mana, reliably supporting Mothman’s ramp, recursion, and counter payoffs.

cards.name: Island
cards.role: Basic land that taps for one blue mana, reliably supporting Mothman’s mill, interaction, and counter payoffs.

cards.name: Swamp
cards.role: Basic land that taps for one black mana, reliably supporting Mothman’s graveyard, removal, and recursion spells.
